activities.name: Shiatsu
activities.subtitle: Finger pressure · care for the body
activities.photoAlt: Shiatsu session at Dojo da Luz
paragraphs: Shiatsu is a traditional Japanese therapy whose name means finger pressure. It works with the body's energy system by applying pressure along the meridians.
It uses fingers, palms, elbows, arms, knees and feet to release tension and support balance of body and mind. It can be used with adults, older people and children.

activities.name: Iaido
activities.subtitle: The art of the Japanese sword
activities.photoAlt: Iaido practice at Dojo da Luz
paragraphs: The Iaido section of Círculo do Silêncio grew from the teaching of Georges Stobbaerts. Practice uses an iaito, a non-sharpened Japanese sword.
It is a non-combative, low-impact physical and mental discipline that develops breathing, coordination, persistence and concentration. More than sport, it is a cultural practice.

activities.name: Tai Chi Chuan
activities.subtitle: Movement, breathing and balance
paragraphs: Tai Chi Chuan works with continuous movement sequences, breathing, coordination and attention.
Practice adapts to different rhythms and is available in the morning, at lunchtime, in the evening or by appointment at weekends.
